native_store_requirement: All mutated graph/required-set/Workflow/node/run/result/origin/coordinator values must be in the same actual native redb transaction domain and authenticated Storage instance. A source-labeled alternative backend is not accepted. Append seglog and SP286 custody remain separately ordered, not cross-store atomic.
retention_boundary: Only listed positive durable families are writable. Compact application binds original afterimage commitments and selector-only native result/origin authority, never full mutable snapshots. Full original source/candidate/afterimage/Event/readback unions are transient. ProducerIntent alone is a distinct runtime-retained intent, not a complete Event or indefinite archive. Original owner source loss refuses full reconciliation/readback; no hash reconstruction or automatic hold.
graph_patch_projection_rule: The requested/validated/applied snapshots are original native staging facts, not prematurely published governance-record redb projections. The one replanned Event carries all three exact full CV315 snapshots and applied record. After first-custody/readback, the existing governance_record.v1:{project_id}:graph_patch:{graph_patch_id} projection derives the exact applied record; requested/validated history remains anchored by that Event plus original phase authority. No second Event family or unregistered seglog write.
key_equality_predicate: All scope components equal actual authenticated invocation and every duplicate inner record identity; outer storage_instance_id equals scope.storage_instance_id. The exact complete physical_key is independently derived, byte-equal and collision checked. Unqualified scope fields on compact Stored* keys mean record.scope; observer/checkpoint identities follow their whole original selectors. NativeIntakeSource intake_id comes from its whole aggregate_intake metadata. No caller-selected original_record_id alias exists.
scope_rule: All H inputs are exact Unicode-scalar UTF-8 lower hexadecimal without normalization; all decimals canonical nonnegative no leading zeros except zero. storage_instance_id in wrappers equals enrollment and actual native handle; physical_key is computed from the exact listed whole-record fields.
